name: ASTER / ESTER
oneLine: A long-running identity, model and runtime research line.
short: The Ester family spans identity, memory, models, voice, runtime and documentary systems.
reality: Multiple source and documentary artifacts survived; the final closeout bounds model, runtime and identity claims.

name: ONE LIFE / IARA
oneLine: An autonomy and living-life research line.
short: Identity, memory, providers, body clients and action boundaries were investigated as separate layers.
reality: Architecture and artifacts survived, but operational continuity is bounded by the final closeout.

name: MODELPERSON / ESTER NEURAL
oneLine: A model-person and neural research line.
short: The record separates person, model and runtime rather than treating them as one object.
reality: Model and training artifacts are documented, but active deployment is not assumed.

name: MINECRAFTLAB / BODY
oneLine: A body-and-world integration experiment.
short: Movement, observation and environment were treated as a distinct layer around Ester.
reality: Body/world evidence is preserved with runtime claims bounded by Archaeology 052.

name: ARQUIVO E³
oneLine: A documentary system created to organize and evidence other projects.
short: Books, indexes, canon rules and evidence boundaries form the recovered E³ record.
reality: The documentary system survived; fictional canon and historical fact remain explicitly separated.

name: ELIOT
oneLine: A character record preserved as a bounded documentary project.
short: The archive separates character material from the systems that documented it.
reality: Eliot is closed archaeologically with personal-data and provenance boundaries.

name: ELOWA
oneLine: A character and dataset line preserved with privacy boundaries.
short: The record distinguishes data, identity and claims about the project.
reality: Closed with unresolved provenance and private-data risks retained.

name: EMOJILIFE / EMOJILAB
oneLine: An experimental project preserved as an unfinished record.
short: The final closeout keeps its surviving evidence and unknowns separate.
reality: Archaeologically closed; implementation and runtime claims remain bounded.

name: FORGOTTEN COMPANIONS / HYTALE
oneLine: A game-oriented creative project with unfinished history.
short: The record preserves project intent without turning assets into a finished game claim.
reality: Closed with asset, build and runtime gaps preserved.

name: BEYOND POWERS
oneLine: A separate game project preserved as Beyond Powers.
short: Its identity is kept separate from Beyond Racing 3D.
reality: Final state is bounded by Archaeology 062; playable claims are not generalized from files alone.

name: AI GAME BATTLE / THE ARENA
oneLine: A sequence of AI game-generation battles and preserved submissions.
short: The final closeout bounds Arena, Battle and submission claims by evidence.
reality: Competition artifacts survive, but missing early records and model/runtime boundaries remain explicit.

name: PAVI EMS P0
oneLine: A Speeduino-based ECU ecosystem with calibration and tooling.
short: P0 reached a bounded ecosystem around an existing base, not a fully proven vehicle-control product.
reality: Firmware/calibration/protocol and partial physical evidence remain separated by the final freeze.

name: PAVI EMS P1
oneLine: A bottom-up custom ECU architecture and schematic line.
short: Architecture and schematic work survived; PCB, firmware/runtime and hardware were not proven.
reality: A substantial design record, frozen before end-to-end implementation.

name: FT300-X / FUELTECH RESEARCH
oneLine: Static FT300 package, firmware and USB/CAN research.
short: Valid package-derived HEX, passive captures and five-slot reconstruction survived; flash and boot did not.
reality: Read-only reverse engineering and tooling, with no proven custom firmware or engine control.
artifact: valid HEX + passive captures + slot reconstruction

name: PAVI EMS P0.5X REV.A
oneLine: A named upstream Speeduino 0.4.4d SMD audit context.
short: The dedicated P0.5X project root was empty; upstream material was not promoted into a custom ECU.
reality: Documentation/validation package only; no dedicated schematic, PCB, firmware or physical closeout.

name: AIRENGINE
oneLine: A mechanical CAD/exchange package, not an AI engine.
short: Air Engine V2 building-block geometry and exchange formats survived.
reality: CAD assets only; no software source, runtime, manufacture or ASTER bridge was confirmed.

name: ROTARY / WANKEL / GEROTOR
oneLine: A targeted negative recovery for a rotary-engine project.
short: Generic/reference roots were found, but no authored concept, CAD, calculation or test artifact was recovered.
reality: The missing primary artifact is the final archaeological result.

name: PROJETO ENGINE
oneLine: A preserved engine-simulator distribution with a separate lab prototype.
short: The distribution includes `.mr` configurations and a rotary module; the EXE was not executed.
reality: Build/source artifacts survived, but successful runtime remains unconfirmed.

name: ENGINE LAB
oneLine: A small Python/Pygame RPM, torque, audio and 2D visualization experiment.
short: One source file implements a simplified model, keyboard throttle, drawing and audio paths.
reality: Source prototype only; no packaged build, runtime proof, combustion model, AI or rotary support.

name: ARQUIVO INACABADO_
oneLine: The report and freeze infrastructure for the unfinished archive.
short: Its archaeology is frozen while future archive/site development remains open.
reality: The report tree survived; an independent site source, build or deployment was not recovered.
